standards_claimed: UNI SONET OC-3 multimode fiber physical layer specification
notes: Case operating temperature: HFBR-5961LZ/GZ 0 °C to +70 °C; HFBR-5961ALZ/AGZ -40 °C to +85 °C. HFBR-5961GZ/AGZ have no EMI shield. Supply VCC 2.97–3.63 V (3.3 V nominal). Transmitter power dissipation typical 0.4 W max 0.64 W; receiver typical 0.225 W max 0.44 W. Optical extinction ratio also specified as 0.02–0.2 %dB (Note 9). Output optical power measured at 1 m of noted fiber with cladding modes removed; BOL/EOL aging <1 dB per datasheet vs 1.5 dB industry for 1300 nm LEDs. Rx min input power OC-3 BER ≤1×10⁻¹⁰; FE BER ≤2.5×10⁻¹⁰. Signal Detect assert uses PA = PD+1.5 dB relative to deassert threshold PD. Spectral width FWHM table shows values 63 nm and 147 nm (table formatting ambiguous). Jitter specifications are in ns p-p, not ps.
suggestions: Add fields for legacy PECL/LVPECL host electrical interface and separate per-SKU temp_min_c/temp_max_c when one datasheet covers multiple orderable parts. Consider ns vs ps for jitter fields.
